app.footer: Money is held in escrow and only released when independent verifiers confirm the proof. No single person can freeze or unfreeze a campaign.

banner.sample: Figures below are sample data and actions only change this browser session.
banner.staleDetail: The ledger API stopped responding. Figures are the last copy received and may be out of date.

freezeReasons.1: Duplicate receipt detected — the same evidence nullifier was used twice
freezeReasons.2: Too many forged receipts — rejected evidence exceeded the allowed ratio
freezeReasons.3: Spending tried to exceed a declared category budget
freezeReasons.4: Verifier quorum upheld a challenge against this campaign

overview.title: Every rupee, followed until it reaches someone.
overview.lead: Funds wait in escrow and release in tranches only after vendors sign receipts and independent verifiers agree. When fraud signals appear, the campaign is frozen and payouts stop.
overview.none: No campaigns have been published yet.

campaign.voteRecorded: Your vote is recorded. Another verifier must also vote.
campaign.quorumOnly: Only a verifier quorum can lift a freeze — never a single admin.
campaign.categoryNote: Spending is tracked against each category budget declared by the NGO.
campaign.msgPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
campaign.msgFrozen: This campaign is frozen; new donations are paused until verifiers resolve it.
campaign.msgExceeds: That would exceed the campaign goal. At most {{amount}} mUSD can still be donated.
campaign.msgThanks: Thank you — {{amount}} mUSD is now held in escrow.
campaign.msgPrefilled: Amount filled in by voice: {{amount}} mUSD. Review it and press Donate to confirm.

release.frozen: Release refused: this campaign is frozen.
release.lowScore: Release refused: impact score {{score}} is below the required {{required}}.

trace.title: Follow a donation
trace.none: No donation traces are available yet.
trace.combined: Combined score of every stage below.

evidence.title: Receipts and verifier quorum
evidence.submitNote: Each receipt gets a unique nullifier, so it can never be reused in another campaign.
evidence.msgFill: Fill in vendor, category and a positive amount.
evidence.msgSubmitted: Receipt submitted. A commitment and nullifier were recorded; verifiers will now review it.
evidence.duplicate: Same nullifier appears on another receipt — possible reuse.
evidence.voted: You have voted on this receipt. Other verifiers must complete the quorum.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.note: Statistical signals are prompts for review, not proof of fraud. Only rule breaches with an on-chain reason freeze a campaign.

proof.title: Check a delivery
proof.lead: NGOs publish only a Merkle root of delivery commitments. A beneficiary (or anyone they share their receipt with) can prove inclusion here — no names or personal data go on-chain. This is commitment-based selective disclosure, not zero-knowledge. The check runs entirely in your browser.
proof.invalid: Each value must be a 32-byte hex string starting with 0x (66 characters).
proof.ok: Delivery confirmed. This leaf is included in the published delivery root.
proof.notIncluded: Not included. This leaf and proof do not lead to the published root.

voice.notUnderstood: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Say “help” to hear what you can say.
voice.noVoice: This device has no English voice installed, so replies are shown as text only.
voice.unsupported: Voice input needs Chrome or Edge. You can still type commands below.
voice.privacy: Your browser converts speech to text. In Chrome and Edge the audio is sent to the browser maker's speech service. Nothing is stored by this dashboard.
voice.errorPermission: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings and try again.
voice.errorNoSpeech: I didn't hear anything. Try again a little closer to the microphone.
voice.errorNetwork: The speech service couldn't be reached. Check the connection, or type the command.
voice.help: You can say: “open alerts”, “open campaign 2”, “show flood relief”, “switch to verifier”, “switch to Hindi”, “show critical alerts”, “show pending receipts”, “donate 10 to campaign 1”, “read this page”, “go back” or “scroll down”.

done.donateWhich: Which campaign? Say, for example, “donate {{amount}} to campaign 1”.
